title: Cart Recommendations
meta: Add on suggestions in your cart and at checkout that help shoppers complete a better order. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Cart recommendations that suggest the right add ons
overview: The cart is where a small, useful suggestion helps most. We add a recommendations block to your cart page or drawer, such as a charger with a phone case or a care kit with a bag. Items are chosen by rules or order data, with clear prices and one tap add. We keep the checkout path short, test all discount cases and make sure shoppers can always remove an item and continue.

faq: We design it to help, not block. Suggestions sit below the cart items, are easy to ignore and never force a purchase. We test the full flow, so the path to payment stays quick.
Can I use it with Shop Pay or Apple Pay?
Yes. Suggestions appear in the cart, so express checkout buttons still work. Checkout page upsells depend on your platform plan, and we confirm what is allowed before we build.
Low priced, clearly useful items usually work best. We help you choose from your catalog and avoid suggesting products that duplicate what the shopper already added.
We keep wording friendly and clear, with no countdown pressure or hidden items. The goal is to help people find a useful extra, and they can ignore it with no effort.
